Ahoo-Wang/CoApi.description: Streamlining HTTP client definition in Spring 6, CoApi provides zero boilerplate code auto-configuration for more convenient and efficient interface calls
Ahoo-Wang/CoApi.body:
# CoApi

> [Documentation](https://coapi.ahoo.me/) | [Chinese documentation](https://coapi.ahoo.me/zh/) | [Chinese README](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/CoApi/blob/HEAD/README.zh-CN.md)

**Zero-boilerplate Spring HTTP Interface clients, reactive or synchronous.**

Spring's [HTTP Interface](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference/integration/rest-clients.html#rest-http-interface) lets you declare an HTTP API as an `@HttpExchange` interface. You still have to build a client, an adapter and a proxy, and register a bean, for every interface. CoApi does that for you: annotate the interface with `@CoApi` and inject it.

- **Reactive or sync**: backed by `WebClient` or `RestClient`, chosen by `coapi.mode` or inferred from the classpath.
- **Client-side load balancing**: `serviceId`, `lb://` or `@LoadBalanced`, via Spring Cloud LoadBalancer.
- **Configurable per client**: override base URLs, load balancing, filters and interceptors with `coapi.clients.<name>.*`.
- **Extensible**: builder customizer beans, replaceable beans, and a refreshing bearer-token filter.

## Compatibility

| CoApi | Spring Boot | Spring Framework | JDK |
|-------|-------------|------------------|-----|
| 3.x | 4.x | 7.x | 17+ |…

# ZCode Desktop Russian Localization

Unofficial Russian (ru-RU) localization for ZCode Desktop, a GUI client for an
AI coding agent. The official app ships with English and Chinese only; this
project adds a full Russian UI: settings, menus, dialogs, tray, About window
(~4,900 strings).

Works with **any version** of the app: the installer extracts `app.asar`,
locates the needed files by code signatures, and applies patches. Untranslated
strings from newer versions simply show in English — nothing breaks.

## Installation (automatic)

1. Fully quit ZCode (including the tray icon).
2. Download the archive from the [Releases](https://github.com/AnikLabs/zcode-ru-localization/blob/HEAD/../../releases) page (file
   `zcode-ru-localization-vX.X.X.zip`), unpack it, and run
   **`РусификаторZCode.exe`**.
3. Pick your ZCode folder → click "Install Russian language".
4. Start ZCode — the UI is now in Russian.

A GUI-free alternative is PowerShell:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install-ru.ps1 [-InstallDir "C:\path\to\ZCode"]

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22

bunhine0452/Ocul-PM.body:
Start with two lines for the Claude Code plugin, and add the desktop app if you want to see the records on screen. Codex · Cursor · Gemini CLI are also recorded with a single rule file. There is no server or account, and the app does not call any LLM.

[oculpm.com](https://oculpm.com) · [Wiki](https://oculpm.com/wiki) · [Download](https://github.com/bunhine0452/Ocul-PM/releases/latest) · [Changelog](https://github.com/bunhine0452/Ocul-PM/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md) · [Issues](https://github.com/bunhine0452/Ocul-PM/issues) Korean · [English](https://github.com/bunhine0452/Ocul-PM/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) --- When an agent finishes a task, it says "Done." That statement does not show whether the tests actually passed, which files were changed and why, or whether anything was missed. To check, you have to reread the diff and logs from the beginning, and the next day's new conversation doesn't even have that context. ```text /plugin marketplace add bunhine0452/Ocul-PM /plugin install oculpm@oculpm ``` With these two lines in Claude Code, you're ready to start (no app needed). To view the records on screen, [download the app](https://github.com/bunhine0452/Ocul-PM/releases/latest) — macOS, Windows · Linux (beta). Instead of that statement, Ocul leaves a receipt. When you place one rule file (`AGENTS.md`) in the project folder, the agent writes a markdown journal to `.oculpm/journal/` each time it finishes a task. The next conversation starts by receiving that journal along with the remaining plan — completion conditions · verification commands · the last verdict — as its starting context and continues from there. From those records, the app expands **only what people need to see**: failed verdicts, journals without command evidence, changes that appear in no journal, blocked items, and decisions that belong to people. Items with established evidence fold into a single line. Since the records are all markdown files, you can commit them together with the code, and they remain readable even without the app.…

joylyboy/douyin-live-monitor.body:
# Douyin Live Room Start/Stop Monitor

Automatically monitors a batch of Douyin live rooms. Once a room goes live or ends, it sends a push notification to iPhone via Bark. Tapping the notification can open Douyin directly to the corresponding live room using the URL Scheme (`snssdk1128://live`).

## How It Works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[External timer / GitHub Actions trigger] --> B[Run monitor.py]
    B --> C[Read rooms.txt]
    C --> D[Request live.douyin.com/room one by one]
    D --> E{Page contains m3u8/flv stream URL?}
    E -- Yes --> F[Judged as live]
    E -- No --> G[Judged as offline]
    F & G --> H[Compare with last state]
    H --> I[If state changed, send Bark]
    I --> J[Tap notification to open Douyin live room]
```

Basis for judgment: The `liveStatus` field in Douyin's web SSR also returns `normal` for rooms that are currently live (unreliable). However, on offline room pages, the count of real stream URLs such as `m3u8/flv/pull_url` is 0, while live rooms contain many. Therefore, "the page contains real stream URLs" is used as the reliable signal for being live. If the page cannot be fetched or an error occurs, no notification is sent in that run (to prevent false positives).

## File Descriptions

- `monitor.py` — Main program: reads rooms.txt, detects going live, sends Bark notifications, writes state.json.
- `rooms.txt` — Monitoring list. Only this file needs to be edited; monitor.py does not need to be touched.
- `state.json` — Runtime state (last live status), maintained automatically by the program and added to .gitignore.
- `add_room.ps1` — Script for adding rooms from the local command line, independent of this tool (see below).
- `add_room.py` — Python version with the same functionality (backup).
- `.github/workflows/douyin-monitor.yml` — GitHub Actions workflow (native schedule as a fallback).

## rooms.txt Format

One room per line, comma-separated: "link or identifier, display name":

    https://live.douyin.com/125093611494, 子成老师讲家庭教育
    https://v.douyin.com/1_AyxhJoFkc/, 羽川电商

- The display name can be omitted (short links automatically look up the nickname using sec_uid).
- Supported formats:
  - Numeric room ID only / Douyin ID (username)
  - `live.douyin.com/room ID`
  - `v.douyin.com/xxxx`…

mlkgrnt/dsh-junimo.body:
# dsh-junimo

**Simplified Chinese** · [Traditional Chinese](https://github.com/mlkgrnt/dsh-junimo/blob/HEAD/README.zh-Hant.md) · [English](https://github.com/mlkgrnt/dsh-junimo/blob/HEAD/README.en-US.md) · [Español](https://github.com/mlkgrnt/dsh-junimo/blob/HEAD/README.es-ES.md)

DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides 37 control tools for Stardew Valley, and adds deployment self-checks and game lifecycle management that the MCP layer cannot cover.

## Overview

This repository is a **dsh bundle** that operates on the profile layer of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

Game logic is not implemented here. All 37 tools are provided by `junimo-mcp.exe` (OCaml, single file) from [Junimo-MCP](https://github.com/mlkgrnt/Junimo-MCP). They are bridged over the stdio MCP protocol by the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`, and appear to the model as `mcp__junimo__<tool name>`. **This repository does not modify any code in Junimo-MCP.**

The plugin itself has four responsibilities:

1. Assemble the MCP bridge, and provide the `junimoPaths` service as the single source of truth for the exe and skill directories
2. Inject Stardew Valley operating discipline into the system prompt, to avoid common timing and save-file errors
3. Register 4 native tools: diagnostics, window focus, game launch, and load save
4. Register a read-only "Season Calendar Panel" in the right sidebar of the dsh Web UI

Item 3 cannot be implemented as MCP tools, because the mod runs inside the game process. It cannot start its own process or bring its own window to the front. Item 4 is implemented by one host route plus a prebuilt client bundle. See "[Season Calendar Panel](#季历面板)".

`junimo-mcp.exe` is bundled in the package (`bin/`, v3.2.2, 6 MB), so no separate binary download is needed after installing the plugin.

## Architecture

```
Model ──mcp__junimo__*──▶ dsh-mcp-client ──stdio──▶ junimo-mcp.exe ──HTTP──▶ executor mod ──▶ game
                              ▲                          ▲
                        dsh-junimo assembly…
```

# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## Features

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.
- **Earnings records**: today, cumulative, paid, pending payment, frozen, and minimum payment amounts; also shows USD valuations with source and timestamp.
- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.
- **Network visualization**: regional distribution donut chart, miner count rankings, slot occupancy, task progress, and tier overview.

[ENG](https://github.com/te9c/jellyfin-plugin-shikimori/blob/HEAD/README_ENG.md)

# About the plugin

This plugin downloads metadata from the [Shikimori](https://shikimori.io) website.

The plugin supports downloading metadata for anime movies and series. It downloads ratings, descriptions, posters, genres, and studios.

For better search results, you can add a tag in the form `[shikimori-12345]` to the media file name or root folder name, where the number is the id from the Shikimori website.

# Installation

1. Go to Administration -> Dashboard -> Plugins -> Repositories -> New Repository.
2. Enter a name, and in the "Repository URL" field enter:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/te9c/jellyfin-plugin-shikimori/main/manifest.json
```
3. Install the plugin from the catalog.

# Building

1. Install the [.NET10 SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/10.0)
2. Clone this repository
3. Build the plugin with the following command:
```bash
dotnet publish --configuration Release --output bin
```

wlrwx/football-engine.description: Sporttery football probability analysis system - Dixon-Coles + Monte Carlo ensemble model, fully automated on GitHub Actions
wlrwx/football-engine.body:
# Sporttery Engine

A probability analysis and virtual betting simulation system for Sporttery football. It is based on the Dixon-Coles Poisson model plus Monte Carlo simulation, with market probabilities dominating the fusion, Kelly criterion for virtual stake allocation, and fully automatic operation on GitHub Actions at zero server cost. **For data analysis and algorithm learning only. It does not constitute any betting advice; all outputs are virtual bookkeeping.**

## Core Principles (driven by 2026-08 data evidence)

1. **The market is the benchmark**: Based on 426 ledger matches, the pure market (vig-removed) Brier score of 0.583 outperforms any model stream (0.646+). The fusion weight is therefore market-dominant (0.75), with models and third-party sources only fine-tuning.
2. **Every switch is decided by data**: Each step of the fusion chain is a config switch (`config/prediction.json["fusion"]["post_fusion"]`). Whether each stays is decided by paired replay of settled ledgers via `scripts/ablation_replay.py`.
3. **Self-evolution with guardrails**: Any automatic enabling of the calibration layer or LGBM must pass a time-based split plus a paired significance test. It is automatically disabled on degradation. See `docs/UPGRADE2_20260829.md`.

## Architecture

```
Daily loop: fetch data → fusion prediction (fusion.py, fully traced) → lock → settle → self-learning
Weekly loop: backtest → weight optimization (champion/challenger) → parameter refit → Monday health check
Evolution loop: clean samples (chain=v2) accumulate → calibration layer auto re-enable/disable (calibration_auto)
                      → LGBM shadow training + validation (lgbm_shadow) → weekly effectiveness evaluation (tracker)
```

## Tech Stack

- Python 3.12 / numpy / scikit-learn / LightGBM / joblib
- GitHub Actions (computation) + GitHub Pages (reports)
- No database; plain CSV/JSON with git versioning; ledgers are append-only

## Directory Structure

```
engine/
├── prediction/     # dixon_coles / monte_carlo / fusion (pure functions + switches + trace) / lgbm
├── strategy/       # kelly / odds-signal gate / hot-zone stake sizing / edge capping / three-ticket system
├── learning/       # fusion_optimizer (weight self-tuning) / calibration_auto (calibration self-evolution)
│                   # lgbm_shadow (shadow training) / league_params / elo
├──…
```

xiaomoL444/ugc-tool.body:
# ugc-tools

## Download
```
git clone https://github.com/xiaomoL444/ugc-tool
```

## Project setup
```
pnpm install
```

### Compiles and hot-reloads for development
```
pnpm run serve
```

In the development environment, all OSS requests go through the same-origin `/ugc-tool-data/...` proxy:

- It first tries to read `https://oss.xiaomol444.xyz/ugc-tool-data-beta/...`.
- Only when the beta file returns **404** does it read `https://oss.xiaomol444.xyz/ugc-tool-data/...`. Network errors, 403, 5xx, and similar responses do not trigger the fallback.
- JSON, translation tables, images, audio, and video all follow the same rule, and media Range requests are supported. The response header `X-Ugc-Data-Source` shows the actual source, either `beta` or `production`.
- The beta `data.json` should contain the complete index for the tool (both production and test content). The two JSON files are not merged automatically per entry. Only newly added or modified resources need to be uploaded to the beta directory; shared resources can remain in the production directory.
- For example: the index goes in `ugc-tool-data-beta/EffectPlayer/data.json`, and a new image goes in `ugc-tool-data-beta/EffectPlayer/icon/123.png`. Images not uploaded to beta are automatically read from the production directory. Translation tables are also overridden as whole files.
- The development proxy response forbids browser caching, so cached production resources do not hide newly uploaded beta files. After updating the proxy configuration, `pnpm run serve` must be restarted.

Production builds still connect directly to the production OSS. The existing priority of `VUE_APP_OSS_BASE` is unchanged. If it is set to another address, requests will use that address and will not go through the default proxy above.

Run the proxy regression test with `node scripts/test-dev-oss-proxy.cjs`.

### Compiles and minifies for production
```
pnpm run build
```

### Cloudflare Pages build

The build root directory should point to the directory that contains this project's `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`. The build command is `pnpm run build`, and the output directory is `dist`. When publishing the source, also commit the updated dependency manifest and lock file. The build environment installs dependencies first and then runs the build. If automatic installation is disabled, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in the build step before building.

# TGFile

## English

**TGFile** is a clean, efficient, and versatile iOS app that brings Telegram file management and media playback together.

Some of its features include:

1. **Save and forward restricted content**  
   Save and forward content from restricted channels and groups that your account can access.

2. **Customize file thumbnails**  
   Choose custom thumbnails when sending or forwarding files.

3. **Turn files into media messages**  
   Forward media sent as files as photos, videos, or audio, with spoiler options for photos and videos. Preview or play media files directly without waiting for the full download.

4. **Optimized file transfers**  
   Improved download and upload performance for faster, smoother transfers.

5. **Multiple accounts and bots**  
   Manage multiple Telegram accounts and bots in one app.

6. **Versatile media playback**  
   Watch videos, listen to audio, and view images directly in the app, with support for a wide range of formats.

7. **Background transfers**  
   Support for downloading, uploading, and forwarding in the background.

8. **Multilingual interface**  
   Use TGFile in your preferred language.
